How to read a plan

  • one box = one instance's declared footprint: x-extent (from the footprint note) by depth, at true scale
  • dot = its true anchor; n inside the box = instance index; repeats run along x by spread
  • label = slot × repeats; the right-hand table carries every drawn number
  • field law z = -8.00 is hard, the rear glass z = -10.02 is measured and stricter
  • the frame law is drawn where the engine mounts it: authored ±14.35 m × x_scale 1.34375 = ±19.283 m world
